prices.status: Published component prices for a planning estimate; not a negotiated quote or a capacity reservation.

aws_direct_connect_flat_rate.verification_method: Read the live pricing page and its embedded pricing table in the browser with Direct Connect Flat Rate Tier set to Tier1.
notes: The second AWS port is included for redundancy; a 100-Gbps pair provides 100 Gbps of usable capacity, not 200 Gbps.
The fixed rate includes AWS port hours and outbound transfer from AWS Regions covered by the selected tier.
A single unpaired flat-rate connection costs the same as a port-pair at the same bandwidth and tier.
Do not add the pay-as-you-go AWS Direct Connect port-hour or per-GB egress charges to this covered flat-rate path.

google_cross_cloud_interconnect.verification_method: Read the Cross-Cloud Interconnect pricing table through web retrieval and verified the same rates in the live browser page.
google_cross_cloud_interconnect.product: Cross-Cloud Interconnect, not Partner Cross-Cloud Interconnect
notes: Google charges separately for the primary and redundant circuits and VLAN attachments.
The reverse evaluator-to-garbler traffic is the Google outbound transfer charged at $0.02/GiB.
The Google compute resources and their VLAN attachments must be in the same region to avoid additional cross-region transfer charges.
Application awareness and optional VPN services are not included.

assumptions: AWS hosts the garbler and Google Cloud hosts the evaluator, so the dominant garbled-circuit traffic leaves AWS on the flat-rate path.
The selected AWS dedicated ports are eligible for flat-rate Tier1 and can form a qualifying port-pair with the chosen Google primary and redundant physical connections.
The AWS dedicated connection and all its virtual interfaces belong to the same AWS account. Hosted connections are not eligible for AWS flat-rate billing.
Primary and redundant Google connections use different edge availability domains within the selected metro; the basic pair corresponds to Google's documented 99.9% availability topology.

The model scales the published component prices across multiple bundles. Provider acceptance, physical capacity, connection quotas, VLAN quotas, and regional aggregate bandwidth are not guaranteed by these prices.
The application can distribute traffic across the provisioned links and machines; modeled link utilization is a separate parameter.

items: Any separately charged cross-connect, colocation, or last-mile provider fees, including any provider-specific installation charges.
AWS Transit Gateway or Cloud WAN processing, SiteLink, optional VPN, and other services not used in the assumed direct private path.
Taxes, support plans, initial database migration, and workload-independent setup labor.
excluded_costs.one_time_fees_note: No numeric one-time setup fee is included. AWS pay-as-you-go Direct Connect pricing explicitly states that AWS has no setup charges; the reviewed Google Cross-Cloud Interconnect table lists circuit hours, attachment hours, and data transfer without a separate setup-fee line. This does not establish that every physical deployment has zero third-party setup charges.

internet_reference_prices.status: Optional comparison only. Applying these rates to exabytes per year is an extrapolation of list prices, not a quote.

aws.unit_note: The reviewed EC2 and Direct Connect pricing pages label the billing unit GB without an unambiguous byte definition. A comparison must state its byte-conversion assumption.

policy.pricing_proxy: Both parties use existing AWS instance/gp3 prices for compute and storage
policy.cpu_model: Existing model: CPU cost is assumed hidden by transfer/loading, not benchmarked
policy.latency: Assumed RTT; finite deterministic scheduler traces, not measurements
policy.workload: Flat private key-value reads; no application-write replication or MPT traversal
policy.bandwidth: Full simultaneous modeled NIC bursts reserved; 10% link-capacity headroom
policy.excluded: Initial construction, client transport, taxes, support, optional middleboxes and third-party fees

The offered rate is 10000 queries/s to this batch stream
Binary-counter occupancy is averaged, not a tail guarantee
56GB/s active DRAM per worker is a proxy, not a measured rate

Random OT preprocessing does not remove dependent online payload products

schedule.scheduler: Pooled foreground, preemptive SRPT background, oldest-ready state
